simple.summary: אֲמָנָה (ʼĂmânâh) means Amanah , a mountain near Damascus First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 5 12.

definitions.full: H549. Amanah אֲמָנָה proper name, of a river 1 a river ( constant ? compare Isa 33:16 ) flowing down from Antilebanon into the plain of Damascus 2Kin 5:12 (Qr; אֲבָנָה Kt), the Greek Chrysorrhoas , modern Arabic Nahr Barad'. 2. the region from which it flows ct 4:8 .
